```plato
//==
// # Joints
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - 2D joints
//  - 3D joints
//  - Joint limits and motors

//==
// # 2D joints
//
// The planar joint zoo: revolute, prismatic, and distance joints. BodyA and
// BodyB are zero-based indices into the simulation's body array; -1 attaches
// that side to the static world. Anchors and axes are expressed in the owning
// body's local frame, in meters.

// A planar one-degree-of-freedom rotational joint: the bodies rotate about
// the out-of-plane axis through the coinciding anchors.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Revolute_joint)
type RevoluteJoint2D
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    AnchorA: Point2D;
    AnchorB: Point2D;
    Limit: AngularLimit;
    Motor: JointMotor;
}

// A planar one-degree-of-freedom translational joint: the bodies slide along
// AxisA (in body A's frame) with relative rotation locked.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prismatic_joint)
type PrismaticJoint2D
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    AnchorA: Point2D;
    AnchorB: Point2D;
    AxisA: Direction2D;
    Limit: LinearLimit;
    Motor: JointMotor;
}

// A planar joint that keeps the distance between two anchor points within
// [MinLength, MaxLength].
type DistanceJoint2D
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    AnchorA: Point2D;
    AnchorB: Point2D;
    MinLength: Length;
    MaxLength: Length;
}

//==
// # 3D joints
//
// The spatial joint zoo (hinges, ball-sockets, sliders, welds, ropes,
// springs, pulleys, the configurable six-degree-of-freedom joint, and gear
// coupling) plus the ragdoll wiring that groups them. BodyA and BodyB are
// zero-based indices into the simulation's body array; -1 attaches that side
// to the static world. Anchors, axes, and frames are expressed in the owning
// body's local frame, in meters. (Skeletal animation owns the bare name Bone;
// every type here is *Joint- or *Constraint-suffixed.)

// A one-degree-of-freedom rotational joint (door hinge, wheel axle). The
// bodies rotate relative to each other only about the axis through the
// anchors; AxisA and AxisB are the hinge axis in each body's local frame.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Revolute_joint)
type HingeJoint
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    AnchorA: Point3D;
    AnchorB: Point3D;
    AxisA: Direction3D;
    AxisB: Direction3D;
    Limit: AngularLimit;
    Motor: JointMotor;
}

// A three-degree-of-freedom rotational joint (shoulder, hip): the anchors
// coincide while orientation is free. TwistAxisA is the twist reference axis
// in body A's frame; SwingLimit bounds the cone deviation from that axis and
// TwistLimit bounds rotation about it.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ball_joint)
type BallSocketJoint
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    AnchorA: Point3D;
    AnchorB: Point3D;
    TwistAxisA: Direction3D;
    SwingLimit: AngularLimit;
    TwistLimit: AngularLimit;
}

// A one-degree-of-freedom translational joint (piston): the bodies slide
// along AxisA with relative rotation locked.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prismatic_joint)
type SliderJoint
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    AnchorA: Point3D;
    AnchorB: Point3D;
    AxisA: Direction3D;
    Limit: LinearLimit;
    Motor: JointMotor;
}

// A joint that locks all six degrees of freedom, welding two bodies into one
// rigid assembly. RelativePose is body B's pose expressed in body A's frame.
type FixedJoint
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    RelativePose: Pose3D;
}

// A joint that keeps the distance between two anchor points within
// [MinLength, MaxLength] (a rope when MinLength is zero, a rod when the
// bounds are equal).
type DistanceJoint
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    AnchorA: Point3D;
    AnchorB: Point3D;
    MinLength: Length;
    MaxLength: Length;
}

// A damped spring between two anchor points: it exerts force
// -Stiffness * (length - RestLength) - Damping * lengthRate along the line
// between the anchors.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hooke%27s_law)
type SpringJoint
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    AnchorA: Point3D;
    AnchorB: Point3D;
    RestLength: Length;
    Stiffness: Stiffness;
    Damping: DampingCoefficient;
}
```
